evals.prompt: Build a MaxCut application, but the SDK, metric, and delivery target are not specified.
evals.expected_output: A reviewable contract that separates resolved facts, defaults, and blocking decisions before planning.
expectations: Asks for unresolved SDK and delivery choices during interactive Intake
Defaults only execution to a local simulator when interactive questioning is unavailable
Does not claim the QAOA route is validated

evals.prompt: Run my existing circuit on TianYan hardware and expose the result in a local demo.
evals.expected_output: A clear blocker that hardware execution is outside the current local-only workflow, without collecting credentials.
expectations: Reports hardware execution as unsupported in the current workflow

evals.prompt: Use quantum machine learning to predict temperature. Select an appropriate SDK and model for me.
evals.expected_output: A QML intent contract that dispatches evidence research without preselecting the implementation route.
expectations: Uses selected_sdk null with sdk_selection_source planner_pending
Does not select an SDK, VQR, encoding, ansatz, optimizer, or backend
Records unknown dataset provenance as a structured unresolved decision

evals.prompt: Build a local FastAPI QML demo, but implementation has not started.
evals.expected_output: A minimal intake manifest that records delivery intent without inventing implementation details.
expectations: Uses onboard as the network source
Does not invent entrypoints, endpoints, assets, or browser selectors

evals.prompt: 生成一个金融欺诈检测的量子机器学习算法应用
evals.expected_output: An interactive Intake that asks for SDK, execution mode, and delivery form, followed by a reviewable full-delivery contract for the selected Qiskit/local-simulator/Web route.
expectations: Asks for SDK, execution mode, and delivery form before scientific preferences when those choices are missing
Preserves Qiskit as the explicit user-selected SDK
Records selected_sdk qiskit with sdk_policy user_locked and sdk_selection_source user_selected
Records execution_mode local_simulator and does not request quantum-cloud credentials
Records delivery_profile runnable_app with an inference-only Web presentation
Carries the approved contract through planning, implementation, verification, and browser handoff
